cases.note: values move up and down but never change in number
three full flats in a row lose the middle one
the largest of three neighbours: only growth
the smallest of three neighbours: only loss
the exclusive or of the two neighbours: both
the sum of three neighbours modulo 4: both
every flat copies the one above: a shift keeps the total
